links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of confidence metrics for LLM ultrasound answers (ROC AUC, ECE)
links.effect: Top Weighted Score hybrid metric had highest discrimination, AUC 0.826 (Gemini-3-Pro) and 0.767 (GPT-5); lowest ECE in GPT-5 (0.098) and Claude-4.5-Sonnet (0.192).
links.quote: Receiver operating characteristic analysis revealed that Top Weighted Score demonstrated the highest discriminative ability, with area under the curve values of 0.826 (95% CI 0.731-0.920) for Gemini-3-Pro and 0.767 (95% CI 0.668-0.866) for GPT-5.

unlisted_practices: Consistency-based confidence estimation via repeated sampling of LLM outputs
Hybrid confidence score combining response frequency and self-reported confidence
Tracking processing time and token consumption of confidence estimation

screen.reason: The study empirically tests and compares various confidence quantification methods (self-reported, consistency-based, and hybrid) as a deployment guardrail for safe use of multimodal LLMs in radiology case interpretation.
